title: 第二十五章 木叶白牙第二十六章 激战白牙
lines: 第二十五章木叶白牙
两日后，夜天云回到了地下交易所，在兑换赏金的同时也想接一个高级别的任务。
经此一战，他对于自己的实力已有了大概的认知，若底牌尽出，对付一般的上忍不成问题，若加上幽夜的能力，除却寥寥数人，无人能威胁到他的性命。
不过为了锻炼自己，不到万不得已，夜天云并不会动用幽夜的能力。
依旧是昏暗的大厅，昏黄的灯光，依旧是那个中年负责人，不同的是厅中空无一人。
“夜大人，这是您的赏金，您点一下。”中年人谄媚的说道。”您身上带着许多的现金不方便，需不需要开户，我们帮您保存？”
“你们这里可以存钱？好吧。。”夜天云微微惊讶了一下，心想：“怎么跟银行差不多。”
“给我看看B级以上的任务。”夜天云直奔主题。
“好的。”负责人立刻答应，拿出了任务簿递给了夜天云。
夜天云翻了几页，目光定格在了一名叫鬼灯半月的上忍上，心道：“鬼灯一族的，嗯，赏金五千万，竟然这么高，有意思。”
“就他了。”夜天云指了下这个任务。
负责人先是一脸的谄笑，不过当他看到了任务目标的画像时，顿时一愣，神色严肃了起来。
“呦，夜大人，您还是换个任务吧，赏金虽高，但不好做。”
“我正想问你呢，这赏金有些惊人啊。”夜天云此时产生了好奇心，想一探究竟。
“不瞒您说，这个任务发布了近三年了，还无人敢接。”中年人话中透出了无奈之情，他顿了顿，继续道：“他并不是叛忍，而是雾忍村在职的上忍，若只是如此，麻烦也不太大，只是具情报，他和三代水影还沾亲带故，所以没有赏金猎人愿意触这个霉头，而且。。”中年人顿了下，继续道：“他的资料不全，但身份恐不止是个普通上忍那般简单。”
夜天云沉思了一会，却是问了另两个问题。
“战争时期的在职上忍也可成为目标？还有，这任务的期限为何会有八个月之多？”
“夜大人，您是新人，也难怪不知道。各个国家为了削弱他国的实力可谓无所不用其极，战场上他们要击杀对方的主要战力，待到这些上忍回村休整后他们也会派高手刺杀，在地下交易所发布任务也成为了一种途径。”
“至于刺杀在职上忍的期限，大多在六个月以上，当然了，叛忍例外。因为上忍出动后大约半年就会回村，或是休整，或是领取其他任务，这也是对上忍的保护，不过要是您的实力够强，也可以潜入两军阵前虎口拔牙。”中年人语气倒也诚恳，显然说的是实情。
“既然如此，我就接这个任务了。”夜天云话语中透出一丝兴奋。
“好吧。”负责人劝说无果，也不在多说，将任务的详细资料拿给了夜天云。
“对了，我在挑一个吧，八个月的时间，太过漫长了。”夜天云翻了一翻，找到了一个木叶的叛忍，领取了任务后，转身离去。
夜天云离开后，负责人啐了口痰：“好心当作驴肝肺，钱财虽好，但也得有命消受。”
实际上，夜天云并未在意赏金，而是因为对鬼灯半月那特殊的血迹加不明的身份很感兴趣。就算杀掉了鬼灯半月又如何，战争时期雾忍村怎会为了一个上忍而不顾全大局，而且三代水影想要查还得花些功夫。
走出了地下交易所，夜天云细细研读着那名木叶叛忍的资料。
任务目标是小泉三郎，本是木叶上忍，前几日被风之国利诱叛逃，情报称他此时已来到风火两国的边境。
翌日下午，夜天云已踏出了雨之国的国境，正在火之国的南部赶路。
火之国境内是一片林海，枝繁叶茂，松柏缠绕相交，隐天蔽日，下午，正是阳光正烈之时，却因遮天的枝叶阻挡，林中略显昏暗。
夜天云打起了十二分精神，时刻使用魂知探知近身的状况。丛林，埋伏的绝佳地点，虽然自己尽捡着写偏僻的道儿走，难保不会被战火波及。
“加快脚步，以免夜长梦多。”夜天云心想。
突然，魂知范围中一道黑影闪过，速度奇快，连身形都无法甄别，夜天云心中一凛，“不好，是高手。”夜天云急忙定住了身形，转身望去。
映入他眼帘的是一个银发男子，面若寒霜，让人望而生畏，眼神看似古井无波，却似把利剑，让人不敢逼视其锋。身着上忍服饰，但左肩处挂着火影式的披肩，背后一把短刀，浑身上下散发着冷冽的气息。
“好像在哪见过，是谁呢？”夜天云心中觉得眼前之人有些面熟，却没有太深的印象。
“你是谁？”银发男子淡淡的问道，声音清冷。
“赏金猎人，你是木叶的忍者？”夜天云方才注意到了男子标志性的护额。
“你来这儿做什么？”银发男子并没有回答夜天云的问题，继续问道。

Chapter 25 Konoha White Fang
Two days later, Ye Tianyun returned to the underground exchange. While exchanging the bounty, he also wanted to take on a high-level mission.
After this battle, he had a general understanding of his own strength. If all his cards were revealed, it would not be a problem to deal with ordinary jounin. If coupled with Yu Ye's ability, no one except for a few people could threaten his life.
However, in order to train himself, Ye Tianyun would not use You Ye's abilities unless absolutely necessary.
It was still a dim hall, with dim lights, and it was still the middle-aged person in charge. The difference was that there was no one in the hall.
"Master Ye, this is your bounty, please click it." The middle-aged man said flatteringly. "It's inconvenient for you to carry a lot of cash with you. Do you need to open an account and we can save it for you?"
"Can you deposit money here? Okay..." Ye Tianyun was slightly surprised and thought: "How come it's almost like a bank."
"Show me the B-level and above tasks." Ye Tianyun went straight to the point.
"Okay." The person in charge agreed immediately, took out the task book and handed it to Ye Tianyun.
Ye Tianyun flipped through a few pages and fixed his gaze on a Jonin named Gui Deng Ban Yue. He thought to himself: "A member of the Gui Deng clan, well, the bounty is 50 million. It's so high. It's interesting."
"That's him." Ye Tianyun pointed at the task.
The person in charge had a flattering smile on his face at first, but when he saw the portrait of the mission target, he was stunned and his expression became serious.
"Hey, Lord Ye, you'd better change the task. Although the reward is high, it's not easy to do."
"I was just about to ask you, this bounty is a bit astonishing." Ye Tianyun became curious at this time and wanted to find out.
"To tell you the truth, this mission has been released for nearly three years, and no one has dared to take it." The middle-aged man's words revealed a sense of helplessness. He paused and continued: "He is not a traitor, but a working jounin of the Mist Ninja Village. If that's all, it won't be too much trouble. Yes, it’s just information. He is related to the Third Mizukage, so no bounty hunter is willing to get into trouble, and..." The middle-aged man paused and continued: "His information is incomplete, but his identity is probably more than just an ordinary jounin."
Ye Tianyun thought for a while, but then asked two other questions.
"Can serving jounin during the war also be a target? Also, why is the duration of this mission as long as eight months?"
"Sir Ye, you are a newcomer, so it's no wonder you don't know. Countries do everything they can to weaken the strength of other countries. On the battlefield, they want to kill each other's main combat force. When these Jonin return to the village to rest, they will also send experts to assassinate them. Publishing tasks on underground exchanges has also become a way."
"As for the time limit for assassinating serving jounin, most of them are more than six months. Of course, rebel ninjas are an exception. This is because a jounin will return to the village about half a year after being deployed, either to rest or to receive other tasks. This is also to protect the jounin. However, if you are strong enough, you can also sneak into the two armies and pull out teeth." The middle-aged man's tone was sincere, and he was obviously telling the truth.
"In that case, I will accept this task." There was a hint of excitement in Ye Tianyun's words.
"Okay." The person in charge tried to persuade her to no avail, and without further explanation, gave Ye Tianyun the details of the mission.
"By the way, I'm choosing one. Eight months is too long." Ye Tianyun rummaged through it and found a rebellious ninja from Konoha. After receiving the mission, he turned and left.
After Ye Tianyun left, the person in charge spat: "Good intentions are like a donkey's liver and lungs. Although money is good, you have to live to spend it."
In fact, Ye Tianyun didn't care about the bounty, but was interested in Ghost Banyue's special bloodstains and unknown identity. So what if he kills Ghost Ban Yue? During the war, how could the Kiri Ninja Village ignore the overall situation for the sake of a jounin? Moreover, the Third Mizukage would have to spend some time to investigate.
After walking out of the underground exchange, Ye Tianyun carefully studied the information on the Konoha rebel.
The target of the mission is Saburo Koizumi, who was originally a jounin of Konoha. He was lured to defect by the Kingdom of Wind a few days ago. Intelligence said that he had arrived at the border of the two countries of Wind and Fire.
The next afternoon, Ye Tianyun had already stepped out of the Kingdom of Rain and was on his way to the south of the Kingdom of Fire.
The territory of the Fire Country is a sea of ​​forests, with lush branches and leaves, intertwined pines and cypresses, hiding the sky and blocking out the sun. In the afternoon, when the sun is shining brightly, the forest is slightly dim because of the branches and leaves that cover the sky.
Ye Tianyun worked hard and used his soul knowledge to detect the situation nearby. The jungle is a perfect place for an ambush. Although I try to take remote paths, I can't guarantee that I won't be affected by the flames of war.
"Speed ​​up your pace to avoid long nights and many dreams." Ye Tianyun thought to himself.
Suddenly, a black shadow flashed across the range of the soul's consciousness. It was so fast that it was impossible to distinguish the figure. Ye Tianyun was shocked, "No, it's a master." Ye Tianyun hurriedly stopped himself and turned around to look.
What caught his eye was a silver-haired man with a face as cold as frost, which made people intimidated. His eyes seemed calm, but they were like sharp swords, making people afraid to look at the edge. Wearing Jōnin attire, but with a Hokage-style shawl hanging on his left shoulder and a short sword behind his back, he exudes a cold aura.
"I think I've seen him somewhere, who is he?" Ye Tianyun felt that the person in front of him looked familiar, but he didn't have a deep impression.
"Who are you?" the silver-haired man asked calmly, his voice cold.
"Bounty hunter, are you a ninja from Konoha?" Ye Tianyun just noticed the man's iconic forehead protector.
"What are you doing here?" The silver-haired man continued to ask without answering Ye Tianyun's question.
